display_name: Marketo: Get Asset Folder By Name
description: Find Marketo folders by exact name, optionally scoped to a root reference, folder_type and workspace. The result can contain several matching folders. Async read writes the metadata to output_tsv_path; poll check_marketo_job_status. All vendor parameters are forwarded.
